albedo_delit.description: Base color, de-lit (no baked lighting). sRGB. 512x512 WebP.

normal.description: Tangent-space normal map, OpenGL convention (+Y up / green = up). Linear. 512x512 WebP.

orm.description: Packed R=Ambient Occlusion, G=Roughness, B=Metallic. Linear. Directly glTF metallicRoughness compatible.

aux.description: Packed R=Height (0.5 = mid-level), G=Curvature (0.5 = flat), B=Cavity. Linear.

preview.description: 256x256 studio-lit sphere thumbnail (sRGB) for previews only; never use as a texture.

shader_conventions.threejs: MeshPhysicalMaterial; aoMap/roughnessMap/metalnessMap all = orm (three reads R/G/B); normal is native.
shader_conventions.gltf: orm is directly the glTF metallicRoughnessTexture (G,B) and occlusionTexture (R).
shader_conventions.blender: Separate Color on orm: Green->Roughness, Blue->Metallic; Normal Map node (OpenGL).
shader_conventions.unreal: DirectX normals: enable 'Flip Green Channel' on normal.webp; ORM packs R=AO G=Roughness B=Metallic (UE native order).
shader_conventions.unity: OpenGL normals (native). URP/Built-in: metallic map + smoothness = 1 - roughness in alpha; HDRP mask map = (Metallic, AO, detail, Smoothness).

weathering_channels.wear: Edge wear / polish on convex crests
